rationale: The 283-pair five electronic-flora exclusion leaves organ datasets from different original source archives. A source-only K-blind 760-pair eligibility audit had already identified 142 of these organ pairs in 24 families with >=20 original-eligible species observed in identical remaining (non-flora) AusTraits dataset IDs.
species_and_dataset_rules: Original frozen positive and finite source-native K-eligible median species, unique genus, native original unit and original independent measurement observation keys exactly retained.
Build positive native-unit median using ONLY nonflora original DatasetIDs on original eligible species, retain only positive medians for both compared organs.

For those same species, find identical nonflora DatasetID with at least one finite positive native-unit observation of EACH trait; retain only the 142 family×organ pairs from K-blind support with >=20 species.

For each paired species calculate 2 organ states under ALL surviving nonflora DatasetIDs (not shared by traits required) and 2 organ states from ONLY DatasetIDs shared by both organ traits on that SAME species.

Both source arms use precisely identical species tips and a single source-pair-specific V.PhyloMaker2 S3 tree; separately on exactly same original GBOTB native prune-only tree with >=20 original tips.

If common nonflora dataset medians are nonpositive for a species, exclude it identically from both source arms; a family×pair with fewer than 20 valid tips gets HOLD, never swapped for a favorable pair.
A shared remaining DatasetID may include multiple original primary studies; original IDs are not identical primary measurements nor genuine source independence.

estimands.primary: The pair-weighted and family-equal fraction of comparisons where K_reproductive>K_vegetative using ONLY source medians from the same remaining nonflora DatasetIDs on identical species and trees, separate S3/prune.
estimands.paired_source_shift: Reproductive−vegetative ΔlogK(common nonflora DatasetID) minus ΔlogK(all surviving nonflora DatasetIDs) on the identical source-selected species and native tree.
sensitivity: Number of source-only K sign inversions on same tips/tree
Exclude seed_dry_mass (Kew SID secondary source concern)
S3 and prune joint sign consistency and holds
Whole-family bootstrap 5000 replicates with deterministic seed 20261017
Family-specific positive and opposing source-qualified case descriptions

scientific_stop_rule: This is explicitly a final joint source/taxon sensitivity after seeing all original organ results. The source eligibility was fixed without using new K outcomes, but organ class and the five Flora IDs arose after original K outcomes.

After reporting source-only joint restriction, no more discovery-generated positive biological subgroup analyses on the same AusTraits K phenotype archive; move to figures/manuscript and independent primary measurements.
Do not interpret K as an evolutionary rate, stabilizing selection, alpha or intrinsic trait-specific memory coefficient.
No automated re-opening of closed BIEN 201-system rho and no claim that TRY version 7 primary source independence has been established.
